title: Add 2023 MHT exposure variables to a person-week skeleton — add_lmed_v20230509
text: Derives menopausal hormone therapy (MHT) exposure Swedish prescription registry (LMED) data, using definitions pinned 2023 MHT study. `add_lmed_v20230509()` categorises dispensed product names MHT groups. corrects dispensed durations products whose recorded defined daily doses unreliable. derives approach-based treatment variables.

title: mht: Menopausal hormone therapy exposure definitions for Swedish registry data — mht-package
text: Derives menopausal hormone therapy (MHT) exposure Swedish prescription registry (LMED) data. `mht` categorises dispensed product names MHT groups. corrects dispensed durations. bridges gaps consecutive prescriptions. applies approach-based exposure definitions used Skalkidou-lab MHT studies person-week skeletons.
